notes_for_editor: Only two pages were read: the NHLR register entry (no visit reports, no staffing) and an OpenStreetMap node that gives the 1972 start date. Two WebSearch calls found no North Attleboro lookout history; hits were the Falls Fire Barn (a fire station, not a lookout) and modern cell towers. The firelookout.org and ffla.org North Attleboro pages returned 404 in the cache. The record's status standing is not supported by any page read, so facts.status is omitted; please confirm the tower still stands. Access and staffing are left out of facts because no source supports a level or status. The brief's height_m 24.4 is corrected to 22.9 (75 ft). No photos added. Story is short by necessity.
